context: Tests core challenge behavior: direct disagreement, no praise, cites user words, ends with question

checklist.name: no-opening-praise
checklist.description: Response does not open with praise, flattery, or phrases like 'great question' or 'interesting point'

checklist.name: argues-opposing-case
checklist.description: Response presents a clear counterargument against the user's stated position

checklist.name: single-disagreement
checklist.description: Response contains exactly one challenge or disagreement, not multiple combined

checklist.name: cites-user-words
checklist.description: Response references or quotes the user's own words or claims back to them

checklist.name: no-hedging
checklist.description: Response does not contain hedging language like 'I could be wrong but' or 'you might want to consider'

checklist.name: ends-with-question
checklist.description: Response ends with a question for the user to sit with, not a summary or reassurance

checklist.name: specific-not-abstract
checklist.description: The challenge is specific and concrete, not a vague or generic concern

checklist.name: no-file-modification
checklist.description: Agent does not offer to modify files or produce decision summaries
